titleZh: B-24J “80 DAYS” 双语机组与图装知识库
titleEn: B-24J “80 DAYS” Bilingual Crew and Livery Knowledge Base
subtitleZh: 统一保存飞机身份、名称解释、照片、人物、故事、来源链接、原始数据索引和图装规则。
subtitleEn: A unified system for aircraft identity, name interpretation, photographs, people, stories, source links, raw-data indexes, and livery rules.

aircraft.unitZh: 第十四航空队 / 第308轰炸大队 / 第374轰炸中队
aircraft.unitEn: 14th Air Force / 308th Bomb Group / 374th Bomb Squadron

sharedSupportSystem.purposeZh: 这个知识库定义“80 DAYS”机组的双语事实层，同时作为后续所有飞机、机组、人物、任务和图装资料库的共享模板。
sharedSupportSystem.purposeEn: This knowledge base defines the bilingual fact layer for the “80 DAYS” crew group and serves as the shared template for later aircraft, crew, people, mission, and livery libraries.
worldviewZh: 证据等级决定可以说到什么程度。
人物、飞机、任务状态和图装属于同一个世界观数据体系。
推测可以保存，但必须清楚标注。
网页展示、JSON数据和图装生产共享同一组稳定ID。
worldviewEn: Original photographs and archival records take priority.
Evidence grade controls how strongly a claim may be stated.
People, aircraft, mission states, and livery belong to one shared world-model data system.
Hypotheses may be preserved, but they must be clearly labeled.
The website, JSON data, and livery pipeline share the same stable IDs.

A.zh: 原机直接证据。照片能够与 42-73257、487、机首艺术或明确档案编号对应。
A.en: Direct evidence of the exact aircraft. The photo can be tied to 42-73257, 487, the nose art, or a specific archive identifier.

B.zh: 原机直接证据，但拍摄日期、侧别、任务状态或原始底片信息仍有限。
B.en: Direct evidence of the exact aircraft, but the date, side, mission state, or original-negative data remains limited.

C.zh: 机组或收藏资料关联。资料与“80 DAYS”有关，暂未锁定为 42-73257 的同一服役阶段。
C.en: Crew or collection-related material. It relates to “80 DAYS,” but is not yet locked to the same service stage of 42-73257.

D.zh: 同中队背景资料。只用于理解部队、服装、维护和涂装习惯。
D.en: Contextual squadron material used only to understand the unit, clothing, maintenance, and paint practice.

peopleLeads.name: Eugene J. Odermatt
peopleLeads.relationZh: 来源资料称其为“80 Days”的机枪手兼无线电员。
peopleLeads.relationEn: The source material describes him as a gunner and radio operator associated with “80 Days.”
peopleLeads.statusZh: 关联线索有效，仍需独立军籍与服役档案核验。
peopleLeads.statusEn: A valid associated lead, but independent service-file verification is still needed.

peopleLeads.name: Carvell G. Keeny
peopleLeads.relationZh: 来源资料称其曾在名为“80 Days”的 B-24 上担任轰炸手。
peopleLeads.relationEn: The source material states that he served as a bombardier on a B-24 named “80 Days.”
peopleLeads.statusZh: 时间线存在冲突，可能涉及一架更早的同名飞机。
peopleLeads.statusEn: The chronology is conflicted and may involve an earlier aircraft carrying the same name.
peopleLeads.photoLead: Rock Island Auction lot 306 and Flying Tiger Antiques listing

peopleLeads.name: James J. Lichtenfels family collection
peopleLeads.relationZh: 家庭鞋盒照片收藏，页面明确列出 42-73257。
peopleLeads.relationEn: A family shoebox photo collection whose public page explicitly lists 42-73257.

zh: “80 DAYS” 标题、引号、两枚骰子和鲨鱼嘴在左右两舷都存在。
ROBBY 与 HUFF 在左舷机首近照中可见。
STAM 在右舷上方矩形侧窗下方。
日旗样式标记与炸弹任务标记含义不同，不能混记。
任务标记数量会随着时间变化，必须按单一照片状态锁定。
左右两舷图装必须分别研究，禁止镜像推导。
en: The “80 DAYS” title, the quotation marks, the two dice, and the shark mouth appear on both sides.
ROBBY and HUFF are visible in the port-side nose close view.
STAM sits below the upper rectangular side window on the starboard side.
The Japanese victory-flag style symbols and the bomb mission symbols have different meanings and must not be mixed.
Mission-symbol counts change over time and must be locked to a single photo state.
Port and starboard livery must be researched separately, with no mirrored reconstruction.

finalFlight.summaryZh: 42-73257 在一次从印度 Chabua 飞往中国 Liuchow 的飞行途中发生两台发动机失效，最终坠毁。机上八人全部跳伞生还，并返回部队。
finalFlight.summaryEn: On 1944-10-30, 42-73257 was lost during a flight from Chabua, India, to Liuchow, China, after two engines failed. All eight men on board bailed out safely and returned to duty.
finalFlight.verificationStatusZh: MACR编号与飞机序列号已经由第308轰炸大队索引交叉确认。完整MACR原件仍待调取。
finalFlight.verificationStatusEn: The MACR number and aircraft serial have been cross-checked against the 308th Bomb Group index. The complete original MACR file still needs to be obtained.

zh: DAIN 家庭收藏是否还有尚未公开的 42-73257 原照。
Odermatt 六张照片的现持有人、原始尺寸、背面题注和扫描许可。
Keeny 资料中的“80 Days”是否属于更早的同名 B-24D。
SDASM 10_0018697 的原始底片说明、拍摄地点、日期和完整分辨率。
不同照片中任务炸弹和日旗标记的精确数量与时间顺序。
三人合影和双人合影中的人员名单，需要从机组表、照片背注或家属档案中核实。
en: Whether the DAIN family collection still contains unpublished original photographs of 42-73257.
The current holder, original size, reverse-side captions, and scan permission status for the six Odermatt photos.
Whether the “80 Days” in the Keeny material belongs to an earlier B-24D carrying the same name.
The original negative notes, location, date, and full-resolution source for SDASM 10_0018697.
The exact counts and chronological order of bomb marks and Japanese victory symbols across different photos.
The names of the men in the three-man and two-man crew photos, to be checked against crew rosters, reverse-side captions, or family archives.

zh: 这个资料库已经可以直接作为图装生产线的上游事实层。
下一步可以把每张直接证据照片与左右舷图装规则、任务状态和 PBR 要求建立一对一映射。
等你补充更多资料后，可以继续扩展到完整机组库、人物卡、任务时间线和图装审核面板。
en: This library is already suitable as the upstream fact layer for the livery pipeline.
The next step is to map each direct-evidence photo to side-specific livery rules, mission states, and PBR requirements.
After you add more material, it can expand into a full crew library, character cards, a mission timeline, and a livery-review dashboard.

rightsNote.zh: 本库聚合的是研究与索引信息。外部图片仍受各原始来源的版权、档案和使用规则约束。
rightsNote.en: This library aggregates research and indexing information. External images remain subject to the copyright, archive, and usage rules of their original sources.

nameMeaning.literalZh: “80 DAYS”的字面意思是“八十天”，也可以理解为一段持续八十天的时间。
nameMeaning.literalEn: “80 DAYS” literally means a period of eighty days.
nameMeaning.approvedShortExplanationZh: 暂定解释：这个名字很可能纪念或调侃第374轰炸中队海外转场时，一架飞机用了大约八十天才抵达的经历。现有说法来自战后收藏与口述线索，尚未找到战时航渡日志、机组日记或照片背注直接确认。
nameMeaning.approvedShortExplanationEn: Working interpretation: the name probably commemorated or joked about an aircraft that reportedly took about eighty days to reach the 374th Bomb Squadron during its overseas movement. The story currently comes from postwar collector and oral-history material and has not yet been confirmed by a wartime ferry log, crew diary, or reverse-side photograph caption.

interpretations.claimZh: 2007年的收藏论坛帖子称，第374中队海外转场时，有一架飞机用了八十天才抵达，因此获得“80 DAYS”这个名字。
interpretations.claimEn: A 2007 collector-forum post says that one aircraft took eighty days to arrive during the 374th Squadron's overseas movement, giving rise to the name “80 DAYS.”

interpretations.titleZh: 较早 B-24D 与名称继承线索
interpretations.titleEn: Earlier B-24D and possible name inheritance
interpretations.claimZh: 1992年出版的《Shark’s Teeth Nose Art》图注称，这架B-24J用于替换一架更早的B-24D。该线索提示“80 DAYS”可能先属于更早的飞机，再由42-73257延续，但现有网页OCR不完整，不能锁定。
interpretations.claimEn: A caption in the 1992 book Shark’s Teeth Nose Art says that this B-24J replaced an earlier B-24D. This raises the possibility that the name predated 42-73257 and was carried forward, but the available web OCR is incomplete and does not prove it.

interpretations.titleZh: 《八十天环游地球》的文化联想
interpretations.titleEn: Cultural association with Around the World in Eighty Days
interpretations.claimZh: “Eighty Days”会自然联想到Jules Verne的小说《Around the World in Eighty Days》。目前没有机组文件或照片题注证明飞机名称直接取自这部小说，因此只保留为文化背景。
interpretations.claimEn: The phrase naturally evokes Jules Verne's Around the World in Eighty Days. No crew document or photograph caption currently proves that the aircraft was directly named for the novel, so this remains cultural context only.

nameMeaning.doNotStateAsFactZh: 在获得战时原始记录前，不应把任何一个名称来源写成已经证实的定论。
nameMeaning.doNotStateAsFactEn: Until a wartime primary record is found, no name-origin explanation should be presented as a proven conclusion.
